SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, (SELECT MAKER_NAME FROM CZ_MAKER Z WHERE CM.MAKER_CODE = Z.MAKER_CODE) MAKER_NAME, (SELECT MODEL_NAME FROM CZ_MODEL Z WHERE CM.MODEL_CODE = Z.MODEL_CODE) MODEL_NAME, (SELECT TRIM_NAME FROM CZ_TRIM Z WHERE CM.TRIM_CODE = Z.TRIM_CODE) TRIM_NAME, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, (SELECT image_url FROM cz_model_image mi WHERE mi.model_code = cm.model_code ORDER BY is_main DESC, sort_order ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS representativeImageUrl, cm.MODEL_CODE FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id
GROUP BY cm.car_id
ORDER BY priceMin ASC ORDER BY km ASC ORDER BY year DESC ORDER BY priceUpdatedAt DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.car_id) FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, pc.maker_name, pc.model_group_name, pc.model_name, pc.trim_name, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.displacement, COALESCE(pc.fuel, cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(pc.transmission, cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(pc.color, cm.color) AS color, COALESCE(pc.body_type, cm.body_type) AS body_type, COALESCE(pc.region, cm.region) AS region, pc.platform_car_id AS platformCarId, pc.platform_name, pc.price, pc.status, pc.pc_url, pc.m_url, DATE_FORMAT(pc.last_seen_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastSeenDate FROM car_master cm INNER JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id WHERE cm.car_id = #{carId} LIMIT 1
SELECT pc.platform_car_id FROM platform_car pc WHERE pc.car_id = #{carId} ORDER BY pc.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT checked_at AS ts, price FROM car_price_history WHERE platform_car_id = #{platformCarId} ORDER BY checked_at ASC
SELECT image_url AS imageUrl, is_main AS isMain, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM cz_model_image WHERE model_code = #{modelCode} ORDER BY is_main DESC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT MAKER_CODE AS code, MAKER_NAME AS name FROM CZ_MAKER ORDER BY name
SELECT model_group_code AS code, model_group_name AS name FROM cz_model_group WHERE MAKER_CODE = #{makerCode} ORDER BY name

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, (SELECT MAKER_NAME FROM CZ_MAKER Z WHERE CM.MAKER_CODE = Z.MAKER_CODE) AS makerName, (SELECT MODEL_NAME FROM CZ_MODEL Z WHERE CM.MODEL_CODE = Z.MODEL_CODE) AS modelName, (SELECT TRIM_NAME FROM CZ_TRIM Z WHERE CM.TRIM_CODE = Z.TRIM_CODE) AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, (SELECT image_url FROM cz_model_image mi WHERE mi.model_code = cm.model_code ORDER BY is_main DESC, sort_order ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id WHERE cm.adv_status = 'ONSALE' GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.body_type, cm.region ORDER BY cm.car_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, (SELECT MAKER_NAME FROM CZ_MAKER Z WHERE CM.MAKER_CODE = Z.MAKER_CODE) AS makerName, (SELECT MODEL_NAME FROM CZ_MODEL Z WHERE CM.MODEL_CODE = Z.MODEL_CODE) AS modelName, (SELECT TRIM_NAME FROM CZ_TRIM Z WHERE CM.TRIM_CODE = Z.TRIM_CODE) AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, (SELECT image_url FROM cz_model_image mi WHERE mi.model_code = cm.model_code ORDER BY is_main DESC, sort_order ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id WHERE cm.adv_status = 'ONSALE' AND cm.updated_at >= #{updatedSince} GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.body_type, cm.region ORDER BY cm.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, (SELECT MAKER_NAME FROM CZ_MAKER Z WHERE CM.MAKER_CODE = Z.MAKER_CODE) AS makerName, (SELECT MODEL_NAME FROM CZ_MODEL Z WHERE CM.MODEL_CODE = Z.MODEL_CODE) AS modelName, (SELECT TRIM_NAME FROM CZ_TRIM Z WHERE CM.TRIM_CODE = Z.TRIM_CODE) AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, (SELECT image_url FROM cz_model_image mi WHERE mi.model_code = cm.model_code ORDER BY is_main DESC, sort_order ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id WHERE cm.car_id = #{carId} GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.body_type, cm.region LIMIT 1
